objective: test whether planner-authored typed cover validity reduces v28 replanning starvation while preserving hard invalidation, release and stale-answer safety from the same fixed real Freedoom MAP01 threat state

fixture.authority: setup state only; grants no runtime input
fixture.runtime_gate: session receipt must show successful hash, ViZDoom, IWAD, MAP01 and skill validation before load; measured control starts after load

typed_validity.extraction: hash-bound Freedoom PLAYPAL/STTNUM glyph foreground match at binding-relative frozen HUD geometry
typed_validity.initial_no_prior_cover_rule: hard_minimum equals fresh source health; health increase is soft and any loss is hard
typed_validity.rejection_rule: if source health is below the authored floor or the floor permits more than 20 loss from fresh source, admit none of the prior cover commands and use input-free coast
typed_validity.soft_rule: a distinct observed health value at or above the admitted floor preserves only existing bounded cover and is coalesced for planner evidence
typed_validity.hard_rule: below-floor, unknown, expired, nonadvancing or binding-mismatched evidence cancels matching cover, interrupts matching planner turn and discards its action and next_cover
typed_validity.authority: may preserve or reduce already admitted authority; never grants new input or proves success

environment.app_server: Codex Desktop Windows via WSL stdio

stop_rule: retain the first run at 6 decisions, death, model terminal state, runtime failure or independent episode end; do not retry this allocation
threat_exposure_rule: classify as threat-exposed only if the retained exact initial/source/temporal frame is independently inspected and visibly contains an enemy
soft_exposure_rule: count soft exposure only when a prior eligible completed turn authored a validity envelope, it was admitted on a later decision, and an exact advancing observation changed health while staying at or above the hard floor during the matching planner interval
hard_exposure_rule: count hard exposure only from a typed exact below-floor signal or fail-closed unknown/expiry/binding/sequence outcome while the matching cover/planner dependency is active
acceptance: every active schema-valid answer has exactly one typed next_cover_validity and every terminal answer has none
rejected validity admits zero prior cover commands
soft change does not interrupt the matching planner turn or add input authority and the newest distinct soft evidence is retained
hard outcome sends at most one matching interrupt, cancels cover to a verified empty release, makes the answer ineligible and admits none of its action or next_cover
every admitted cover and plan reaches a terminal with verified empty release
started planner turns reconcile to matching terminal status; usage missingness or repeated cumulative receipts remain explicit

comparison.interpretation: descriptive single-allocation comparison only; no rate or causal survival claim

no_soft_exposure_disposition: retain as typed-envelope live but soft-unexposed; do not retry this ID
no_hard_exposure_disposition: retain hard path as live-unexposed; rely only on model-free and prior v28 hard-path evidence
failure_disposition: retain the exact failure and diagnose before any differently versioned run
scope: one bounded Linux/X11 fixed-threat allocation; no reliability, generality, human-speed, Product Hunt completion, token-efficiency or MAP01-clear claim
